title: Porsche: restrained industrial presentation
summary: Concentrate product media, space and a small number of controls around one physical decision.
use_when: A durable object or premium service needs a concentrated explanation and one clear next decision.
avoid_when: A control-dense administrative task or a character-led community experience needs many equally available actions.
